name: Controlling High Blood Pressure
certification: Approximation of HEDIS Controlling High Blood Pressure (CBP), not certified: built from NCQA's public measure summary; the licensed HEDIS value sets are not used (codes here are public ICD-10-CM/LOINC/CPT examples).
steward: NCQA (HEDIS CBP); CMS eCQM CMS165 / MSSP APP Quality ID 236
spec_year: CMS165v14 (2026 performance period); HEDIS CBP MY2025 (2027 Star Ratings C14)

citations.title: eCQI Resource Center: CMS165v14 Controlling High Blood Pressure (2026 performance period)
NCQA public measure page: Controlling High Blood Pressure (CBP)
NCQA public measure page: Blood Pressure Control for Patients With Hypertension (BPC-E)
2027 Part C & D Star Ratings Technical Notes (last updated 09/30/2026; measurement year 2025 data)
Medicare Shared Savings Program Quality Performance Standard: PY2026 40th Percentile MIPS Quality Performance Category Score (Dec 2025), Table 1 APP Plus Quality Measure Set

denominator.summary: Members 18-85 at period end with hypertension (I10-I13, I16 or Agere hypertension concept) diagnosed before or during the first six months of the period (CMS165 convention); enrolled.

exclusions.label: Hospice or palliative care (Z51.5 / hospice encounter)
End-stage renal disease or dialysis (N18.6, Z99.2)

numerator.summary: Representative BP = most recent date in the period with both readings; lowest systolic and diastolic on that date; controlled when < 140/90. No reading = not controlled.

gap_label: Hypertension: latest BP not below 140/90 (or no BP this period)

outreach.action: BP recheck / home cuff; PCP follow-up

notes: HEDIS excludes readings taken in acute inpatient or ED settings; measurement setting is not received for vitals.
